title.en: Plastic Pipes Operating Temperatures: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump keeps 144 kW is Diesel 60
title.zh: 塑料 管道 运行 温度：LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管保留「是 145 kW。」

description.en: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump. 144 kW is Diesel 60 Diesel 60 is 3500 kg
description.zh: LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管见 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump。是 145 kW。是 50 m³/h。

h1.en: Keep LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump under “Maximum Short Time Operating Temperature” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「短时最高 工作温度」下保留LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump. 144 kW is Diesel 60. Diesel 60 is 3500 kg. That weight is LZ-60. Send the LZ-60 path to /en/contact/. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h and no pipe cell. The outline is published as 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. The label is conveying distance, and 300 m is delivery height. If your order must cite 100 / 125 mm and 50 m³/h together, this is the page that prints both. Do not restack them into Electric 80’s H / V style without saying you copied different labels. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 as 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. The section title “Plastic Pipes Operating Temperatures” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管的数字。要打开的行是 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump。是 145 kW。是 50 m³/h。这个重量是 LZ-60。144 kW 是柴油60。柴油60是 3500 kg。标题是输送距离，300 m 是输送高度。柴油60印 35 m³/h，并且没有管径格。外形以 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 公布。把 LZ-60 路径发到 /zh/contact/。不要在不说明的情况下把它们排成电动80那种 H / V 写法。如果订单必须同时引用 100 / 125 mm 和 50 m³/h，印出这两项的是这一页。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 印成 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。节标题「塑料 管道 运行 温度」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.zh: 塑料 管道 运行 温度

body.en: Under “Plastic Pipes Operating Temperatures”, LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. 144 kW is Diesel 60. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h and no pipe cell. Do not restack them into Electric 80’s H / V style without saying you copied different labels.
body.zh: 在「塑料 管道 运行 温度」下，LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管这一节只放已印出的格子。144 kW 是柴油60。柴油60印 35 m³/h，并且没有管径格。不要在不说明的情况下把它们排成电动80那种 H / V 写法。

heading.zh: 短时最高 工作温度

body.en: “Maximum Short Time Operating Temperature” titles this part of the LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Diesel 60 is 3500 kg. The outline is published as 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 as 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg.
body.zh: 「短时最高 工作温度」是LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。柴油60是 3500 kg。外形以 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 公布。是 145 kW。

body.en: For LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump, the heading “Heat Distortion Temperature” does not replace a cell. That weight is LZ-60. The label is conveying distance, and 300 m is delivery height.
body.zh: 对LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管而言，标题「热变形温度」并不替换任何格子。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 印成 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。标题是输送距离，300 m 是输送高度。是 50 m³/h。

body.en: LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Vicat Softening Temperature”. Send the LZ-60 path to /en/contact/. If your order must cite 100 / 125 mm and 50 m³/h together, this is the page that prints both. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-operating-pressure-d_1621.html.
body.zh: LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管不因标题「维卡软化温度」而改动。这个重量是 LZ-60。如果订单必须同时引用 100 / 125 mm 和 50 m³/h，印出这两项的是这一页。把 LZ-60 路径发到 /zh/contact/。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-operating-pressure-d_1621.html。

question.en: Does “Plastic Pipes Operating Temperatures” replace 144 kW is Diesel 60?
question.zh: 「塑料 管道 运行 温度」会替换「是 145 kW。」吗？

answer.en: No. 144 kW is Diesel 60 remains the printed wording for LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 145 kW。仍是LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 60 is 3500 kg belong on the LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管这一行里，「是 50 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Maximum Short Time Operating Temperature” add to LZ 60 Diesel Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「短时最高 工作温度」给LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-operating-pressure-d_1621.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-operating-pressure-d_1621.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside 144 kW is Diesel 60?
